editions.title: SOFR was 3 basis points below IORB on 8 October
editions.description: SOFR was 3.87%, compared with IORB at 3.90%, on 8 October 2026. The SOFR–IORB difference was −3 basis points; the SOFR 99th percentile was 3.95%, or 5 basis points above IORB.
editions.headline_finding: SOFR was 3.87%, compared with IORB at 3.90%, on 8 October 2026. The SOFR–IORB difference was −3 basis points; the SOFR 99th percentile was 3.95%, or 5 basis points above IORB.
editions.coverage: Nine US dollar-funding inputs; eight observations dated 8 October 2026 and weekly-average reserves dated 7 October.
limitations: A fixed 8 October funding review, not the latest observation for every instrument.
System funding evidence does not measure an individual institution's liquidity or probability of failure.
A rate difference alone does not establish rising or falling stress; this brief makes no historical trend claim.
Reserve balances are a weekly average for the week ended 7 October; other rows have separate source dates.
Archive time begins at first verified capture. This is not complete historical publisher-vintage data.

editions.title: ESAF: net NPA ratio fell, gross ratio stayed at 5.4%
editions.description: A dated, source-linked comparison of ESAF's March and June 2026 disclosures, with editable data and original charts.
editions.headline_finding: ESAF reported NNPA of 0.8% at June 2026 versus 1.8% in March. GNPA remained 5.4% at reported precision, while its gross NPA balance increased from INR 1,213.9 crore to INR 1,253.3 crore.
limitations: One selected issuer; not a census or representative bank sample.
Historical comparison is read in the July presentation; it is not a backdated publication-vintage dataset.
Ratios are displayed at issuer precision; gross and net NPA denominators differ.
A falling ratio does not identify recoveries or explain the contribution of provisions, sales, write-offs or loan growth.
No live withdrawal, complete counterparty exposure or intraday liquidity evidence is supplied.
CET1 and LCR are missing in the selected API projection, not proven absent from all issuer disclosures.
The PDF was checked through official-source web text. Direct local downloads returned HTTP 403; its API-reported hash is not independently verified in this run.
